image_description: Three stylized, futuristic loudspeaker units arranged in a row against a white background. The speakers feature non-standard, complex geometries with exposed internal components, circular drivers, and metallic/plastic finishes. The left unit has a vertical rectangular shape with a large orange-rimmed driver and blue internal structures. The middle unit is partially obscured but shows similar complex internals. The right unit is taller and narrower with two vertically stacked circular drivers.

The surfaces of the circular drivers lack realistic material definition (e.g., cone ridges, dust cap seams). They appear as smooth, slightly melted gradients rather than distinct physical components.
The top edge of the rightmost speaker curves unnaturally and seems to warp into the background, suggesting slight geometric instability common in AI generation.
The boundary between the internal components and the outer casing of the middle speaker is blurred, with parts appearing to fuse together rather than having distinct separation gaps.
